effects

Visual effects currently available or planned for Nada Vfx.

Standalone effects

Inner Flames

Available

The tighter flame layer used close to the weapon. Nada Vfx rebuilds the vanilla branch at runtime and exposes it as its own configurable effect.

10 modifiersStandalone
Vanilla source
SwordDyrnwyn / attach/Burny vfx/fx_Torch_Basic

Outer Flames

Available

The larger outer flame layer from Dyrnwyn's Burny rig. Nada Vfx separates it from the inner flame and flare so it can be controlled independently.

Vanilla source

Orbital effects

Orbs

Available

The demister's glowing ball repurposed as a path-driven Orbital. Nada Vfx rebuilds only the visual pieces it needs rather than cloning the vanilla networked root.

Vanilla source
